person.narrative: High cost of living and long hours in NYC. Partner works remotely and is open to moving. Considering whether to stay, relocate, or go fully remote.

decision.question: Should we relocate to a lower cost-of-living city?

options.label: Stay in New York
options.description: Keep current job and apartment in NYC. High income but high expenses. Rich social life and career network. Partner's remote work continues.

options.label: Move to Austin
options.description: Transfer to Austin office with a 10% pay cut. Dramatically lower cost of living. Buy a house. Growing tech scene but smaller network. No state income tax.

options.label: Go fully remote
options.description: Negotiate full remote work or find a remote-first company. Move to a mid-size city like Raleigh or Denver. Maximum flexibility but potential career ceiling.

decision.context: Partner works remotely as a freelance designer. No kids yet but planning to start a family in 2-3 years. Both sets of parents are on the East Coast.
